content.text: All public examples pass. Now let me benchmark the worst-case basis optimizer (20 queries):

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import main as m
# worst case: 20 useful queries, 28 requirements
for nreq in (10, 20, 28):
    random.seed(nreq)
    cands = []
    for i in range(20):
        mask = 0
        for b in range(nreq):
            if random.random() < 0.35:
                mask |= 1 << b
        if mask:
            cands.append((mask, random.randint(1,1000), 'q%02d'%i))
    # avoid domination pruning removing everything: call minimum_basis directly
    t = time.time()
    best = m.minimum_basis(cands, nreq)
    print('nreq', nreq, 'ncand', len(cands), 'mask', best, 'time %.3f' % (time.time()-t))
PYEOF
